metaDescription: Westwood Siding won our 2026 Siding & Exterior Cladding award for Mississauga, Ontario. Family-operated GTA siding company serving since 1977.
summary: Westwood Siding is a family-operated siding and exterior renovation company serving Toronto, Mississauga and the surrounding GTA. Founded in 1977, the company installs fiber cement, vinyl, aluminum and wood siding along with soffit, fascia and eavestrough work.

editorial.heading: What they do
editorial.text: Westwood Siding installs fiber cement, vinyl, aluminum and wood siding, along with soffit, fascia and eavestrough work. Covering the full exterior envelope, siding plus soffit, fascia and eavestrough, means a homeowner can coordinate a full exterior refresh with one contractor rather than several trades.

editorial.heading: How they work
editorial.text: As a family-operated business founded in 1977, Westwood Siding has close to five decades of operating history in the GTA market, worth asking about directly for long-term references. Offering four distinct siding materials, from budget vinyl to higher-end fiber cement, gives homeowners a range of price points and maintenance profiles to choose from. Because the company also handles soffit, fascia and eavestrough, it can sequence that work alongside a siding replacement so the whole exterior is finished on a single coordinated schedule rather than staggered across separate contractors.

editorial.heading: What to expect
editorial.text: No customer reviews are published for this listing yet, so ask the company directly for recent local references, particularly for a siding material matching your project, whether fiber cement, vinyl, aluminum or wood. Ask to see completed jobs in your neighbourhood if possible.

editorial.heading: Where they work
editorial.text: The business serves Toronto, Mississauga and the surrounding Greater Toronto Area. Homeowners outside the immediate GTA should confirm coverage before requesting a quote.

strengths: Nearly five decades of operating history in the GTA siding market, founded in 1977.
Installs four distinct siding materials, fiber cement, vinyl, aluminum and wood.
Covers the full exterior envelope, including soffit, fascia and eavestrough, not just siding panels.
Family-operated structure, which can mean consistent staffing and direct accountability on the job.
considerations: No public reviews are listed yet, so ask for recent local references before a full-home siding project.
Best suited to full siding replacement or larger exterior renovation projects; confirm minimum job size for smaller repairs.
Fiber cement siding costs more than vinyl, so ask for a side-by-side comparison of material and labour cost.
Exterior work is weather-dependent, so expect scheduling to concentrate in warmer months.

Anyone comparing vinyl, fiber cement, aluminum and wood siding before deciding

questionsToAsk: What is the cost and maintenance difference between fiber cement and vinyl siding for our home?
Does the quote include soffit, fascia and eavestrough, or are those priced separately?
What manufacturer warranty applies to the siding material, and what is your separate installation warranty?
What is your current lead time from signed quote to installation start?
